PRIMARY_inside_cryosparc_validation_mask.definition: PRIMARY (used on Fig S5 summary boxes and Table S1): 5th / 50th / 95th percentile of RELION --locres values in voxels where the CryoSPARC Validation (FSC) auto-tightened mask > 0.5 (locres finite and > 0)

W3_duplex.SECONDARY_definitions_note: The entries below use other voxel sets and give other ranges; they are kept for reference only and are NOT quoted on the figures or in Table S1. inside_displayed_envelope also sets the Fig S5A colour-bar range.

inside_loose_mask.definition: voxels with loose-mask value >= 0.5 and locres > 0 (0 = not sampled by RELION)

inside_displayed_envelope.definition: voxels above the contour enclosing 65000 A^3 of the loose-mask postprocessed map /n/netscratch/hekstra_lab/Lab/ian_poon/sfgfp_chimera_screening_20261112/relion/W3_duplex/pp_loose/postprocess_masked.mrc (threshold 0.6558); this is what colours the Fig S5A surface

W3_duplex.note: The loose mask (15 A low-pass, 98.5th percentile, +6 px, 8 px soft edge) contains much solvent (W4: ~70 % of the box), so its percentiles are dominated by solvent; the envelope numbers describe the molecule.
